editorial:
If you've ever wanted to see a giant green monster smash through walls while a scientist tries to keep his cool, this movie delivers. Bruce Banner is on the run, hiding from the military while searching for a cure to his anger problem. When the army forces him out of hiding, you get a wild ride packed with explosions, chase scenes, and a showdown with a new villain called the Abomination. The vibe is tense but fun, with plenty of action to keep you glued to the screen.

Edward Norton brings real heart to Bruce, making you care about his struggle. The action scenes are big and loud, and the pacing rarely slows down. On the downside, some of the CGI looks a bit dated now, and the story can feel rushed in places. Still, if you love superhero movies with lots of smashing, this one is a solid pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Bruce transforms into the Hulk and fights the Abomination in the streets. After a brutal clash, Hulk wins by choking out his enemy. Bruce then escapes to a remote cabin, where you see him practicing control over his transformation. In a post-credits scene, Tony Stark approaches General Ross about forming a team, hinting at the Avengers.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves superhero action movies and Marvel fans
